visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and a checkered shirt smiles warmly, carrying a young girl on her shoulders in an indoor home setting. The girl has dark hair in pigtails and wears a white patterned shirt. They are positioned in front of a neutral wall with a modern floor lamp visible in the background. Large white Chinese characters appear as an overlay in the center of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to a wide shot of a grey modular sofa in a bright living room with white tiled floors. A woman and child are seen sitting at the far end of the sofa, which is positioned against beige curtains. The camera pans across the sofa, highlighting its clean lines and adjustable backrests under bright, even indoor lighting. (3) The woman appears in a medium shot, speaking directly to the camera and gesturing with her hands. She is sitting on the grey sofa. Text overlays identify her as 'Participant Luo Xiao Bai'. The background remains the same living room environment with soft shadows and a minimalist aesthetic. (4) Close-up shots demonstrate the mechanical features of the 'Seattle Sofa', specifically the backrest sliding backward to increase seat depth. White dashed lines and an arrow graphic are superimposed on the grey fabric to visually explain the motion. The lighting is bright studio-style, emphasizing the fabric texture. (5) A montage of hands testing a piece of grey fabric shows scissors scratching the surface and water being poured on it. The water beads up and is wiped away with a white tissue, demonstrating durability and water resistance. Large, bold text overlays describe the fabric's properties like 'Scratch Resistant' and 'Water Repellent'. (6) A split-screen comparison shows a 'Before' image of a cluttered living room and an 'After' image of a clean, well-lit space featuring the new sofa and curtains. The 'After' shot has a more cohesive color palette of greys, whites, and beige, with a white coffee table in the center. (7) Detailed shots focus on 'Miss Curtain' products, showing beige cloth curtains combined with sheer white curtains on a black rod. The woman demonstrates the shading effect as the room darkens. The setting is the same living room with a large window leading to a balcony. (8) In a child's room, the woman adjusts blue and white horizontal striped blinds. She uses a grey feather duster to clean them, highlighting their low-maintenance nature. The room contains a dollhouse and toys, lit by soft natural light from the window.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: MR.SOFA CASA. [Subtitle]: 新家開箱第一彈. (2) [Slogan]: 名人大小室 Celebrity Affairs. [Subtitle]: 小宅不能錯過的變形金剛沙發. (3) [Subtitle]: 這張沙發先生家居的西雅圖沙發. (4) [Variety]: 參加者 羅小白. [Subtitle]: 它完美的結合了滑軌和後推式沙發的優點. (5) [Subtitle]: 它比滑軌的展開深度更深, 椅背也可以貼齊牆壁. (6) [Subtitle]: 就不用預留多餘的空間, 讓空間可以更靈活的運用. (7) [Variety]: 客製化. [Subtitle]: 再加上沙發先生家居的貼心客製化服務. (8) [Subtitle]: 他們推薦我把布料改成防刮耐磨防潑水的貓抓布. (9) [Variety]: 防刮、耐磨 防潑水. (10) [Subtitle]: 一張適合小小孩家庭的沙發就這樣完成了. (11) [Variety]: 適合小小孩家庭的沙發. (12) [Subtitle]: 家裡還有一個很低調但我覺得非常重要的家具. (13) [Variety]: 低調但重要. [Subtitle]: 就是窗簾. (14) [Subtitle]: 這個奶茶色的布簾一裝上去之後, 溫馨柔和的感覺一下子就有了. (15) [Variety]: Before / After. (16) [Subtitle]: 窗簾是在沙發先生家居集團的窗簾小姐挑選的. (17) [Logo]: MISS CURTAIN. (18) [Subtitle]: 那因為有考慮到小朋友可能會在客廳睡午覺. (19) [Variety]: 窗簾小姐 布簾+紗簾. (20) [Subtitle]: 服務人員推薦我們全遮光的布料, 另外搭配紗簾. (21) [Subtitle]: 可以柔化光線, 讓客廳保持在一個剛剛好的亮度. (22) [Variety]: 剛剛好的亮度. (23) [Subtitle]: 而且全遮光布料不只能遮擋光線, 還能阻隔熱能. (24) [Variety]: 遮擋光線 隔絕熱能. (25) [Subtitle]: 這樣夏天在室內就不會那麼可怕了. (26) [Variety]: 窗簾小姐 調光簾. (27) [Subtitle]: 兒童房我們選擇的是調光簾, 一樣可以輕鬆調整採光. (28) [Subtitle]: 但相對於布簾沒有那麼厚重, 所以更好清潔. (29) [Subtitle]: 就不容易堆積灰塵還有過敏原. (30) [Variety]: 過敏原OUT!. (31) [Subtitle]: 而且調光簾不像布簾一樣要留一定的深度, 對小坪數來說非常的省空間. (32) [Subtitle]: 推薦給和我們一樣坪數不大的人. (33) [Logo]: 沙發先生家居 MR.SOFA CASA. [Slogan]: 立即預約體驗.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience. An upbeat acoustic pop BGM featuring a rhythmic guitar strumming pattern and light percussion kicks in immediately. A 'pop' SFX is heard as the title text appears. (2) A quick 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers as the scene shifts. The speaker's delivery is fast-paced but clear, maintaining a friendly and persuasive tone. The music stays consistent in tempo and volume, providing a steady energetic backdrop to the narration. (3) A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates the introduction of the sofa brand. The speaker explains technical features with moderate pitch modulation. Ambient noise is virtually non-existent, indicating high-quality studio post-production. The vocal projection is strong and authoritative. (4) Distinct scraping sounds (high-frequency friction) are audible as the fabric is tested with scissors. This is followed by a faint rustling sound of a tissue. The BGM continues smoothly, with the speaker's arousal level remaining high to emphasize product benefits. (5) Another 'whoosh' SFX signals a transition to the curtain segment. The speaker's tone shifts slightly to a more descriptive, informative style. The BGM remains the dominant instrumental layer, maintaining a positive emotional valence throughout the explanation of light-shading properties. (6) A digital 'click' or 'pop' SFX accompanies the appearance of a brand logo. In the child's room segment, subtle mechanical clicking sounds of the blinds being adjusted can be heard. The speaker's voice is well-enunciated, emphasizing ease of cleaning and anti-allergy features. (7) A final 'whoosh' SFX and a short melodic jingle mark the outro. The BGM swells slightly in volume during the last few seconds before fading out into a hard cut at the very end of the brand logo reveal.
